d: Manchester United's problems are getting out of order. Argentina defender Lisandro Martínez has questioned the club's recruitment and director of football Jason Wilcox, while Amad Diallo's social media post has added to the talk around the dressing room. With results in Champions League and Premier League failing to improve, questions are also being asked about Michael Carrick and the club's leadership. Rupha Ramani unpacks the tensions at Old Trafford and why the crisis goes beyond the pitch and score line.
